messages:
kelly-peopleops: Morning team — getting reports of duplicate calendar invites + duplicate scorecard rows from the ATS for ~30 interviews since 07:40. Candidates see two invites; interviewers sometimes submit two scorecards.

omar-recruiter: Seeing it too. Some folks accepted both and are double-booked. ATS says they retried deliveries when they didn't get 2xx.

ravi-platform: Pulled deliveries from our receiver; identical event_id on repeats. Quick fix is to add idempotency in our webhook handler. I'll spin up a short-lived dedupe cache and push a patch.

kelly-peopleops: Short-term triage for interviewers: 1) If you see duplicate invites for the same time, accept the earliest one. 2) Do NOT submit a second scorecard if you already submitted one — DM People Ops with candidate ID. We'll merge duplicates centrally.

ci-bot: CI: patch/evt-dedupe on integration-service -> tests passed.

ravi-platform: Patch deployed to canary. Also prepared a one-off merge script for scorecards. Preview SQL to find dupes: ```SELECT event_id, candidate_id, COUNT(*) as c FROM scorecards WHERE created_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY event_id, candidate_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;```

kelly-peopleops: Schedule: keep ATS retries paused until we confirm canary healthy. Omar, can you hold vendor comms and ask them to pause for 45m?

omar-recruiter: On it. I've asked them to pause retries and requested logs.

elaine-talent: I'll update the interviewer playbook and send a brief note to all interviewers scheduled in the next 48h with the triage steps and a screenshot example.

ravi-platform: Canary stable for 12m, merging to prod now. After deploy I'll run merge job (keep earliest submission, append later comments into merged_notes). Will cancel duplicate calendar events where possible.

kelly-peopleops: Run merge at :15 after deploy; please post results. We'll audit merged records and follow up with any interviewers who lost responses. Thanks.

ravi-platform: Merge finished: 30 duplicates collapsed into canonical rows, 52 duplicate invites canceled. Re-enabled vendor retries after confirmation. Monitoring for 2 hours.

kelly-peopleops: Postmortem actions: require event_id in vendor contract, add idempotency test to integration CI, and add a one-liner in interviewer training: "If duplicates appear, accept earliest, don't resubmit scorecard." Closing for now — ping me if you see more duplicates. :white_check_mark:
